interactions.note: The epitope-specific mAb 24-A6 immunostained LLC-PK1 cells infected with PDCoV strains GX2021-1, GX2022-1, or GX-2022-2. MAb 24-A6 also recognized a 24.6 kDa protein in lysates of PCCoV-infected cells analyzed by western blotting. It did not cross-react with any proteins in the lysates of cells infected with swine acute diarrhea syndrome coronavirus (SADS-CoV), porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV), getah virus (GETV), senecavirus A (SVA) or porcine sapelovirus (PSV).
The epitope-specific mAb 24-A6 immunoprecipitated the M protein as a 24.6 kDa protein  from lysates of cells infected with PDCoV.

The epitope-specific mAb 24-A6 reacted with M protein fragments 80-113 and 94-141, indicating the epitope was located in the overlapping region 94-113. Further analysis of truncated peptides from this region established 103-SPESRL-108 as the minimum epitope.

The minimum epitope recognized by mAb 24-A6 was established by reactivity with trunctaed peptides covering M protein residues 80-217. MAb 24-A6 reacted with fragments 80-113 and 94-141, indicating the epitope was located in the overlapping region 94-113. Further analysis of truncated peptides from this region established 103-SPESRL-108 as the minimum epitope. The epitope is conserved in PDCoV strains and is predicted to be on the intracellular side of the membrane.
